title: Conversation Turn Annotated Event
description: A completed turn was enriched by the turn-enricher service (Jev signal gate + Clairic typed extraction). See bloodbank/docs/event-naming.md and issue #271.

target_event_id.description: id of the source turn.completed event (also this event's causationid).

outcome.description: Terminal disposition copied from the source turn.completed.

signal.description: Jev noul signal: probability the turn contains substantive work output. null when the gate did not answer.

action.description: Clairic: the single main action completed, 2-4 word verb phrase; null when absent or p_null >= 0.5.

artifacts.description: Clairic: named artifacts (versions, ticket ids, file paths, build numbers, model names).

blocker.description: Clairic: the blocking issue if any; null when none or p_null >= 0.5.

working_directory.description: Working directory copied from the source event.
